disasters.title: Fire on the forest road
disasters.description: A fast-moving fire has reached a forest road used by families and supply caravans. Smoke is already obscuring the nearest route.

effects.memory: You helped move travelers away from the forest fire before the road became unsafe.
You helped clear a route through smoke and falling branches.

disasters.title: A sandstorm swallows the caravan route
disasters.description: A sudden sandstorm has separated a supply caravan from its guides. The nearest settlement cannot see the signal posts.

effects.memory: You guided a separated caravan to shelter through the storm.
You helped secure the settlement's water stores while the storm passed.

disasters.title: The coast road floods
disasters.description: A high tide and overnight storm have flooded the coast road. Several homes and supply sheds are cut off from the village.

effects.memory: You helped residents move belongings and reach higher ground before the water rose.

choices.label: Carry dry supplies to the shelter

effects.memory: You carried food and dry blankets to a shelter above the flooded road.

disasters.title: Illness at a border checkpoint
disasters.description: Travelers at a border checkpoint are falling ill, and the small clinic is running short on medicine and clean water.

effects.memory: You helped the checkpoint clinic organize care and keep clean water available.

choices.label: Buy medicine and carry it to the checkpoint

effects.memory: You purchased medicine and carried it to the families waiting at the checkpoint.

opportunities.title: After-hours instruction
opportunities.description: Your instructor notices that you have returned to your studies more than once. They offer to stay late and work through a difficult lesson with you.

choices.label: Stay and work through the lesson
choices.description: Spend another personal choice on focused instruction. Build your academy record and your instructor's confidence in you.

effects.memory: Your instructor stayed after class to help you master a lesson you had struggled with.

choices.label: Take the notes home and rest
choices.description: Keep the advice for later. You lose no action and recover a little morale.

effects.memory: Your instructor gave you notes to review at home after seeing your steady effort.

opportunities.title: The bridge crew needs a hand
opportunities.description: After helping on the road, you reach Nami Village. A bridge crew is organizing supplies and asks whether you can help the community recover.

choices.label: Organize supplies with the crew
choices.description: Spend a personal choice to improve local trade and public trust. Your help also earns a small stipend.

effects.memory: You organized bridge supplies with the people of Nami Village; the route became safer and busier.

choices.label: Carry their report to the next checkpoint
choices.description: Spend a personal choice passing the crew's needs to local officials. Improve security without spending money.

effects.memory: You carried the bridge crew's report to the checkpoint, prompting a safer patrol route.
